title: The Rise of Temujin
description: 1186-1206. Follow Temujin's unification of the Mongol tribes on the steppe: rescue his wife Borte from the Merkits, forge and then break the alliance with Jamukha, defeat the Naiman confederation, and be proclaimed Genghis Khan at the kurultai. The player begins with a small warband and must grow through raids, alliances, and decisive battles.

anachronisms_found: KING x2 used to represent the Merkit chieftain and Tayang Khan of the Naiman — the AoE2 King is a crowned European monarch sprite, entirely wrong for steppe tribal leaders; a Tarkan, Mangudai, or even a heavily-escorted Cavalry Archer/Khan-style hero would have been closer, and the engine offers several Central Asian hero options
CAMEL_RIDER x3 in the enemy roster — the camel rider is a Middle Eastern/Saracen unit; Merkit, Jamukha's Jadaran and Naiman forces fought as horse archers and lancers, not camel cavalry

GUARD_TOWER x2 and PALISADE_WALL/GATE fortifications for a nomadic steppe camp — stone guard towers are inappropriate for the 12th-century Merkit/Naiman, who moved with felt tents and had no masonry defences

Jamukha, a central figure named repeatedly in the text, is represented by no hero or distinct player at all — his 'gifts and warriors' and his betrayal are just CREATE_OBJECT spawns from the same generic Player Two roster
